semantic_audit.paper_year_scenario_contribution: [FishMAE: A Masked Autoencoder based framework for long-term fish re-identification](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0144860926000622), Aquacultural Engineering114(2026)102746, DOI10.1016/j.aquaeng.2026.102746, is verified by the publisher, which links this exact repository. It studies MAE pretraining plus CE/triplet long-term individual retrieval on a laboratory fish dataset across nine sessions over five months. README lacks a paper citation, but external primary evidence resolves publication identity. Published retrieval results are not our native MFT26 MOT measurements.
semantic_audit.code_and_pretrained_license: Exact complete Git path inventory contains no LICENSE/COPYING and README gives no project source/data/weight grant. MAE-style/timm/PyTorch dependencies have separate upstream rights, but those do not establish FishMAE derivative file or unknown fish dataset/checkpoint permissions. This audit is read-only with explicit source-execution/reuse exclusion until rights are verified; no code was copied, run or imported, and no weights/data were downloaded. Absence of terms is recorded rather than assumed permissive.
semantic_audit.entrypoints_and_training_inference: README commands point to mae-fish/train_mae.py and fish_reid_mae/train.py, yet both actually use imported Python configs with blank-space paths, not argparse flags --config/--pretrained/--data_path. train_mae imports a local simple engine distinct from root engine_pretrain; root main_pretrain.py is the original CLI and asserts timm0.3.2. ReID train creates MAEReID, fits CE/triplet, evaluates every5epochs and saves model-only files. evaluate/feature_extractor/matcher provide offline image embedding/retrieval, not a current/past native tracker.
semantic_audit.core_model_files_and_shapes: mae_vit_base_patch16 is ViTBase768/12blocks/12heads with224x224 input,14x14=196patches; decoder512/8blocks/16heads predicts16x16x3=768pixels per patch. Pretrain adds fixed sin-cos patch positions before75% masking. MAEReID manually embeds all patches, adds only CLS position, runs encoder blocks/LN and extracts CLS768 through BN/classifier. It omits patch positional addition in both dummy and actual ReID forward, unlike pretrained encoder. Global CLS-only output is not K4/K8 fish-local identity evidence; rectangular128x256 is unsupported by square patchify/position assumptions without disclosed adaptation.
semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: MAE minimizes normalized per-patch RGB reconstruction MSE over masked tokens, not a stopped EMA latent JEPA loss. ReID trains CE plus batch-hard triplet margin1 on L2-normalized BN features. Positive mask equals class and excludes all zero distances (including identical duplicate positive views), negatives differ. Config P8,K4/B32 is not enforced: RandomIdentitySampler never uses p to form batches, concatenates views then globally shuffles all indices; len uses ceil chunks while final partial chunks are not padded, so length/batch composition can differ. No explicit same-frame hard negatives, anatomy, visibility labels or dense latent targets.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: train_mae asserts a blank PRETRAIN_PATH exists then reads official MAE checkpoint[model]; no hash/terms/url/physical fish training exposure is established. It writes both nested model_state_dict checkpoints and raw state_dict files. MAEReID directly load_state_dict(ckpt,strict=False) expects raw model tensor mapping, so supplying root main_pretrain nested model checkpoint or nested resume dict can silently miss all encoder tensors unless coverage is checked. Model.eval() during construction does not freeze parameters; ReID train.model.train and optimizer(model.parameters) train backbone/BN. Fish dataset identities/splits, official payload and MFT26 overlap are not verified.
semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: Backbone embeds a single crop, with no temporal/future image input. Offline eval query uses session2 and gallery other sessions, filters same-ID/same-camera positives, and has no past-time guard. data_split.py oppositely calls session2 gallery/others query, so helper directory names and eval logic differ. Generic recursive MAE image loading has no fold exclusion unless caller supplies a fit-only root. Strict online adaptation must use current observed crops, past predicted memory and observable masks; session/camera/GTID fields stay supervision/measurement, not inputs.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: README/requirements request torch2.0.1+cu118/torchvision0.15.2,timm1.0.26,NumPy1.24.4,Matplotlib3.7.5,Pillow12.2.0 and CUDA11.8/Python>=3.8. Root main_pretrain statically asserts timm0.3.2, incompatible with that declared modern requirement. Local simple pretrain loop uses regular backward without AMP; root loop has CUDA autocast/synchronize and scalable distributed tools. No custom CUDA operator is declared for the ViT itself. Actual package resolution/import compatibility is not claimed, no installation or reference execution occurred.
semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: Single-image MAE/CLS can inform an independently licensed fish/self-supervised backbone baseline, but unlicensed source cannot be directly executed/copied. Square RGB224 stretch and global CLS training differ from our aspect-preserving IR detector crops and local anatomy-free tokens; current backbone cannot be labelled DINO/FishDenseJEPA merely by renamed features. Identity folders/filename numeric PID do not ensure physical(video,fish) labels; Market-style same-camera exclusion would discard valid within-video positives. Cold/frozen versus trainable encoder and BN exposure must be separately guarded in all inner/outer folds.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Use independently cleared MAE architecture/weights with explicit payload license and tensor coverage, fit-only fish image reconstruction and matched CE/truePK-triplet global baseline. Distinguish source-faithful missing patch positions from a disclosed position repair, and correct sampler batches in a separately named implementation; do not call repaired weights/sampler a faithful official reproduction. Require complete model/optimizer/RNG resume for our training rather than model-only best.pth. Exclude unknown source/data/checkpoint rights, blank config CLI assumptions, cross-camera offline protocol and MAE pixel decoder being presented as JEPA latent prediction.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: Masked pixel reconstruction and fish global CLS CE/triplet fine-tuning are established MAE/ReID mechanisms. This code has no target EMA, object-centric local latent teacher, temporal candidate relation or full-set association competition, so it neither implements our intended ModuleB nor licenses a novelty claim for generic fishMAE adaptation. A contribution needs same-input frozen/trained MAE versus DINO/CNN/global/local controls, truthful crop/identity causality and full folds/seeds/video metrics, with negative comparisons retained.

This differs from free-swimming IR video MOT; published retrieval/cluster/occlusion findings are not measured native tracking evidence or our inferred causal anatomy labels.
semantic_audit.code_and_pretrained_license: Complete exact-commit Git path inventory contains no LICENSE/COPYING file or accompanying fish checkpoint terms. Public source can be inspected but does not confer a verified permission to execute/copy/adapt these project files. Torchvision/timm/DINO backbone source and weight rights require independent upstream verification, and AutoFish data/published checkpoints are separately unverified. Thus this field is resolved as an explicit reuse/execution exclusion, not a permissive-license assumption; no foreign implementation was run or copied into IR-MFT.
semantic_audit.entrypoints_and_training_inference: GT crop preparation is0_Prepare_gt_crops/prepare_gt_crops.py; zero-shot ResNet/Swin scripts are1_zero_shot_instance_retrieval; training variants reside in2_Fine_tuning_feature_extractors_with_triplet_loss (PyTorch-transform Swin and custom-transform Swin/ResNet).3_Evaluating_on_test_data/Eval_test_data.py loads a configured local state_dict and performs retrieval/plots. These are notebook-export standalone scripts with hardcoded /work3 paths and import-time setup, not a ready online tracker or unified CLI. Correct variant/checkpoint/normalization must be declared.
semantic_audit.core_model_files_and_shapes: Training custom Swin uses torchvision swin_t/ImageNetV1, replaces classification head and adds Linear768->512 then L2 normalization; custom ResNet50/ImageNetV2 replaces fc and adds Linear2048->512 with unnormalized forward. Evaluation recreates these architectures with weights=None and outputs unnormalized512-D embeddings. Zero-shot raw variants expose2048 ResNet/768 Swin/optional384 DINOv2. Images are RGB224-square letterboxed or variant-specific augmented crops; there are no fish local part tokens, temporal state, JEPA teacher or joint detection decoder in this ReID source.
semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: Custom variants use P32,K8 B256,margin0.5 triplet with LpDistance(p2),AvgNonZeroReducer and hard TripletMarginMiner; PyTorch-transform Swin instead declares P4,K4 B16. PKsampler emits complete batch index lists from identities having>=K views and drops low-view identities, with reduced P if needed. Positives are equal fish_id strings and negatives different IDs; no explicit same-frame fish-negative constraint or motion supervision. Model optimizers fit all parameters from ImageNet initialization, LR1e-5/AdamW/300epochs with val-loss plateau scheduler. Library-level normalization defaults are not pinned, so raw-vs-normalized distance must be audited in any independent reproduction.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: Swin training uses torchvision ImageNet1K_V1, ResNet ImageNet1K_V2; zero-shot Swin uses timm pretrained and optional DINOv2 uses torch.hub trust_repo=True without upstream exact pin. Actual trained weights are hardcoded filesystem paths, not an acquired verified public payload. AutoFish data link is vapaau/autofish, with fixed group splits train15/val5/test5 in crop script; README exploration says24folders while preparation includes group25, so actual asset enumeration/physical-ID disjointness needs independent data verification. No data/weights downloaded and no MFT26 overlap claim.
semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: Crop retrieval uses independent still images and randomly chooses one query per identity from the complete test group pool, with all remaining views as gallery. Test eval recreates label maps from test metadata for measurement, not network inputs; this is offline retrieval and may include views later than the query, so it is not causal online tracking. Deployment may use only image features from current crops and past predicted memory; GT masks/identity/random whole-pool galleries are prohibited online. No native timestamp/absence/unknown handling is implemented.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: Scripts import PyTorch/torchvision, PIL/OpenCV, NumPy,timm,faiss,pytorch_metric_learning and plotting/sklearn tools; training chooses CUDA if available but does not use a project custom CUDA extension. No exact requirements lock or complete environment pin appears in the Git inventory. PyTorch metric-learning default mining/distance/AccuracyCalculator self-match semantics depend on installed version; source call alone is insufficient verification. No install, torch.hub load or foreign script execution was performed; unknown license remains a reuse/execution exclusion.
semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: GT preparation blacks out background using GT segmentation then crops a tight padded rectangle, whereas zero-shot helper merely uses the GT mask extent to crop the original image. This foreground distinction and custom mean/std (0.0495,0.0503,0.0535)/(0.1370,0.1363,0.1412) can confound pipeline comparisons. These still-fish RGB/domain statistics are not transferable calibration for horizontal IR detector crops. Physical(video,fish) mapping, equal crop keys/past-only galleries and unknown preservation are required in our independent controls; named fine-grained classification does not imply supervised fish anatomy.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Independently implement verified-license ImageNet CNN/Swin triplet baselines, genuine PK batch composition, aspect-preserving resize and fit-only normalization/crop stability controls rather than transplanting unlicensed scripts. Exclude GT segmentation from online inputs and distinguish GT-mask foreground versus full detector-rectangle crops. Test eval unnormalized embeddings while custom Swin train normalizes; include explicit norm/distance controls. Offline mAP@R is different from all-gallery mAP. Validation AccuracyCalculator passes the same embedding tensor as query/reference without explicit self-match flag; independently ensure self/duplicate/future exclusion and do not infer causal performance from those scores.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: Fish metric learning, ImageNet ResNet/Swin, PK sampling, hard triplet and padding/normalization are existing ReID controls, not EvidenceFishMOT novelty. semantic_audit.entrypoints_and_training_inference: tools/train.py invokes YOLOX training; exps/SU-T.py and optional SU-T-ReID.py configure inference via tools/su_tracker.py. Exact source has two static entry defects: tools imports MOTEvaluatorDance from yolox.evaluators, whose __init__ exports only COCOEvaluator and MOTEvaluator; evaluate_su_t constructs lowercase su_t, although SU_T is imported. Optional evaluate_su_t_reid constructs SU_T_ReID. FastReID training entry is fast_reid/tools/train_net.py. Unchanged official inference is not claimed runnable.
semantic_audit.core_model_files_and_shapes: Default KalmanBoxTracker orig=False constructs custom UKF(dim_x=9,dim_z=5) without fx/hx: state cx,cy,area,confidence,aspect,vx,vy,varea,vconfidence; F is9x9 constant velocity and H5x9 selects observed components. UKF generates19 sigma points and applies F/H when callbacks are absent. The named tracker fx is also linear; orig=True uses7/4 FilterPy dimensions but subsequent matrices are9/5, so that branch is excluded. YOLOX-x config has depth1.33/width1.25,800x1440,one class; optional ResNeSt101/GeM/BN yields2048-D RGB crop embeddings.
semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: Base tracker has no learned identity loss. YOLOX detection uses5xIoU loss plus BCE objectness/class and optional L1 with SimOTA dynamicK selection, not fish ID labels. Optional SBS_S101 inherits B64,K16 NaiveIdentitySampler (P4), CE smoothing0.1 with CircleSoftmax64/margin0.35 plus hardest unnormalized Euclidean triplet and soft-margin at margin0. Labels in mft25.py prefix only numeric pid with MFT25, while video is camera; video-local pid reuse would collide unless input IDs are pre-offset. It does not explicitly construct same-frame fish negatives.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: README detector Checkpoint.pth and ReID-Checkpoint.pth are Baidu distributions, not acquired or hash/license/identity-exposure verified. FastReID config enables pretrained ResNeSt backbone during training; inference disables backbone pretrain and loads supplied ReID weights. MFT25 train/test detector annotations and MFT25-ReID BMP filename labels are configured sources, not independently audited split/overlap evidence. Cannot substitute these payloads for fold-excluded ImageNet fits or call them an unbiased MFT26 baseline.
semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: Tracker update consumes current detections and prior observations; UKF freeze/unfreeze interpolates internal historical missing states when current reappearance arrives. This is causal for current output if prior exported frames are never rewritten, not a future-free estimate of earlier missing frames. None detections return before frame_count/aging, unlike a correctly shaped empty array. No future images or GT should enter deployment; both missing-frame representation and lifecycle must be standardized for an IR-MFT port.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: conda_env.yaml is a full machine export with Python3.10, torch2.6.0+cu118/torchvision0.21, NumPy1.23.4,SciPy1.13.1,FilterPy1.4.5,lap0.5.12,cython-bbox,faiss-gpu and CUDA11.8 packages; no requirements.txt exists at this pin. UKF/association are NumPy/SciPy CPU code; detector/optional FastReID use CUDA. The environment export is not evidence all versions compose or imports run. Reference code was not imported, installed or executed, and no GPU was allocated for this audit.
semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: Compatible mechanisms are current/past boxes, covariance, confidence and fixed geometric shape/area cues. Default UKF is not an implemented nonlinear learned transition. FishIoU central-region coordinates are overwritten by intersection before central_area1, producing a different normalization from standard central IoU; its area/1000 scale also depends on image resolution. Fixed left15%/right25% and vertical30% insets are geometric regions, not annotated fish anatomy. Full tracker swap also changes association stages, aging, birth/output and optional RGB ReID, so cannot isolate motion gains.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Evaluate KF versus true stated UKF with identical state/noise/lifecycle, and source-faithful FishIoU versus explicitly corrected central normalization plus IoU/DIoU, scale and symmetry controls. Keep geometry-only and learned ID evidence separate. Exclude broken entry aliases and dimension branch, unknown checkpoint exposure and unlabelled anatomy claims. FishIoU source score clips IoU+0.3central+0.1aspect+0.2area-0.4(1-exp(-minarea/1000))*normalized_center_dist to[0,1]; changing the overwritten-area behavior must be documented as a repair, not faithful original reproduction.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: UKF/sigma-point filtering, observation-centric recovery, four-corner direction/TCM matching and hand-crafted shape IoU overlap existing tracking literature and HybridSORT/FilterPy source; using them is a baseline or adaptation, not EvidenceFishMOT novelty. A fish-specific learned nonlinear transition or observable occlusion gate would need independent supervision, same-input controls and full-video evidence. This audit establishes code provenance and implementation discrepancies, not a scientifically validated gain.

semantic_audit.entrypoints_and_training_inference: src/train.py task cmot resolves through train_factory to CMotTrainer in lib/trains/mot.py. src/track.py instantiates JDETracker from multitracker.py, not mc_bot_sort. README literal --arch tides/tidel is not a registered factory key; choose tides or tidel explicitly. STrack.__init__ calls update_features before creating its own features deque, but BaseTrack provides inherited class-level features=[], so this is not a missing-attribute crash. Initial feature appends to a shared class list before instance deque replacement; the new queue loses that first history entry. This source behavior needs isolation, not a false entry-failure claim.
semantic_audit.core_model_files_and_shapes: tidel wrapper calls yolo.PoseL using tidel.yaml, whose upsampling backbone returns64-channel features to Conv64 heads; it returns a one-element list of head dictionaries, not the unused raw anchor Detect output. tides wrapper calls FastViT-MA36 builder with stage depths[6,6,18,6],widths[64,128,256,512],three RepMixer stages and final attention. cmot heads are hm1,wh2(or ltrb4),id reid_dim(default128/README64),cnt1,reg2 at stride4 of input1088x608. JDE normalizes/gathers IDs at decoded detection centers; its active KF uses8-D XYAH constant velocity.
semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: CMotLoss combines focal/MSE center heatmap, masked size/offset regression, normalized center-ID features scaled sqrt(2)*log(nID-1) through train-ID CE(ignore -1), ReLU density MSE plus SSIM and density/detection consistency/count terms with detach. Learned uncertainty s_det=-1.85,s_id=s_cnt=-1.05 weights branches. Imported TripletLoss is not the active CMotLoss identity objective. JointDataset offsets IDs per named dataset-list key, not per video; fish IDs must be globally offset or keyed by(video,fish). Shuffled individual frames/drop_last are not PK sampling or explicit same-frame contrastive pairs.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: PoseL builder calls initialize_weights with default pretrained empty: standard module initialization plus heatmap bias-2.19/nonheat head normal0.001, not a verified ImageNet transfer. FastViT get_pose_net passes no pretrained payload. Optional load_model reads supplied checkpoint, skips mismatched shapes, drops unknown keys and fills missing parameters from initialization with strict=False; successful loading alone cannot prove full checkpoint coverage. README Baidu weights and external MFT25/MFT-Edge training/test assets were not acquired, hash/terms/split/identity exposure not verified.
semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: JDETracker consumes one current image tensor and prior track states, current-image center heads and normalized appearance features. GT centers, train IDs and density targets belong to offline JointDataset/loss, not inference. Active association uses appearance+motion gating then ordinary IoU high/low/unconfirmed stages; standalone AGCv1/AGCv2 are not called by matching.ious or iou_distance on this path. AGCv2 has no return; AGCv1 inverse center distance is unguarded at coincident centers. Do not call those definitions a deployed AGCIoU implementation.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: README asks CUDA>=11/Python>=3.8/PyTorch>=1.7, but requirements.txt is a conda-style machine export listing Python3.10.4,torch1.12.1+CUDA11.3,NumPy1.23.1 and compiled extensions, while install command names requirements.yaml. model.py eagerly imports pose_dla_dcn, which imports dcn_v2 DCN even when choosing tides/tidel, so architecture selection alone does not avoid that dependency. semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: Current-image joint detection/ID/density is conceptually compatible with causal operation, but replaces detector/backbone/crops and lifecycle, violating same-input association isolation unless adapted explicitly. Actual JDE path uses heavy appearance costs and ordinary IoU rather than the README minimalist AGCIoU route. Geometry and lightweight-vs-large efficiency need separate fixed-detection controls. Original ID dataset encoding, aspect/stride, current-image density supervision and unverified vendor licenses prevent treating this repo as a plug-in unbiased fish ReID baseline.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Port only independently implemented/cleared geometric or density ideas with explicit observed-input definitions, fixed native tracker and controlled current detections. If implementing paper AGCIoU, obtain its primary mathematical formula and label numerical repairs independently from a source-faithful control; do not transplant unused/incomplete AGCv2 or singular AGCv1 and call it reproduction. Repairing shared first-feature history storage or optional imports creates a modified baseline requiring disclosure. Test branch capacity/latency under the same raw all-frame pipeline before interpreting elastic branch efficiency.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: Joint center detection/identity, density consistency and uncertainty-weighted multitask objectives overlap FairMOT/CMFT-style systems; FastViT and YOLO components are established architectures. Geometric association is a baseline family, not EvidenceFishMOT fine-grained ID or JEPA novelty. Any new local identity/density/occlusion mechanism must show gain beyond equal-capacity/simple pooling and same-detection geometry controls; publisher edge metrics and unused source functions do not establish such a contribution.

semantic_audit.entrypoints_and_training_inference: README src/main.py training -> Trainer -> default dla_34 factory CenterTrack_RGBT in dla_rgbt_main.py; src/test_rgbt.py -> Detector_RGBT -> current modalities/past cache/Tracker. Active DLA stem calls CrossModalDiffusionFusion and DLASeg optionally DiffusionModule at stride4. semantic_audit.core_model_files_and_shapes: DLA34 shares16-channel visible/thermal stem plus past-image/heatmap projections. CrossModalDiffusionFusion default3steps adds Gaussian noise0.01 to both stem features, runs separate2-layer ConvBN denoisers with concatenated cross guidance, updates thermal using freshly updatedRGB and returns their sum. DLA levels/DLAUp yield64-D stride4 features; DiffusionModule predicts scalar spatial noise_scale, adds noise, concatenates32-D step embedding to3Conv/attention/skip stages and residual strength0.2. semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: Trainer GenericLoss optimizes center FastFocal plus masked gathered L1 box/backward-offset heads; no separate diffusion epsilon/noise reconstruction objective, stochastic-time loss, stopped EMA JEPA target or identity contrastive loss appears in this active training path. Denoise/refiner parameters learn through these detection/regression losses. Dataset supplies disturbed GT prior heatmaps and equal-trackID displacement targets; training prev-image uses abs(frame difference) and can be future. Random image/context batches are not physical fish PK or same-frame ID-negative construction.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: DLA34 pulls ImageNet ba72cf86 when no model path; README lists Baidu pretrained DM3T and inherited VT-MOT assets, not acquired/hash/terms/exposure verified here. semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: Current aligned visible/thermal and previous cached inputs can be causal; reset and cache update occur per sequential video inference. Exclude unknown weights/data, optional imported attention as active architecture, bidirectional train context and whole altered detector/tracker as a fish ID contribution.

Offline teacher generation sees the whole sequence and global depth maximum, so those maps must remain training targets; supplying them as online observed inputs would violate strict causality. This original pipeline uses future/test-video adaptation and is excluded from strict online ModuleB/D. Backbone features for one frame are spatial, but that alone does not make the fitted whole-video tracker causal. Prefix-only reimplementation would be a modified method needing complete separate data/runtime controls.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: README Python3.9; requirements torch2.1.0/torchvision0.16,xformers0.0.22.post7,antialiased_cnns,einops,kornia,OpenCV and media tools. Multiple helpers hardcode cuda:0 or RangeNormalizer default cuda, training calls cuda.empty_cache and can retain whole video/dense features/trajectories on GPU. DINO/RAFT upstream accelerators and total per-video optimization/preprocessing/anchor cost dominate original runtime; per-point cached inference alone is not fair raw online FPS. No dependency install, source model forward/training or GPU allocation occurred in this audit.
semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: Full-video test-time adaptation and future-anchor occlusion violate our current/past-only inference and independent train/inner/outer folds. Saliency/point-consistency occlusion is a prediction/proxy, not GT fish visibility/anatomy. Dense grid point tracks cannot directly replace fish-box physical IDs,birth,absence,reactivation or unknown handling. Runtime cost requires preprocessing/10kfit plus future-required outputs and is not comparable to native V3 fixed proposals unless adapted transparently. Optional supplied benchmark segmentation/query labels remain evaluation/sampling inputs and are prohibited as online fishGT.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Independently implement cleared residual feature refinement and point/local correspondence consistency as fit-only same-input controls if useful, with fixed global/local features and no target-video fitting. For observable occlusion, use only past/current support and distinguish source future-anchor offline proxy from prefix-only adaptation. Exclude original full-video model/feature/anchor caches,test-time training,unverified hub payloads and GT query/mask input from strict online tests. Genuine DenseJEPA needs its own stopped EMA current/future training targets, causal object context and candidate relations; this source point-tracker is not that method.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: Residual DINO feature refinement, optical-flow pseudo correspondence,cycle consistency and contrastive semantic preservation already belong to DINO-Tracker and related point tracking prior. Adapting them or generating point tracks alone is not new fish identity evidence. EvidenceFishMOT must show learned local identity support/relations beyond equal-input contrastive/localTransformer controls with causal folds/seeds/native video metrics. No source completion/point benchmark result can establish online fish identity improvement or novel latent target learning.

SAM2ImagePredictor accepts current image/point-box-mask prompts. semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: SAM2Train simulates point/box/mask prompts and correction points from GT object masks, RandomUniformSampler chooses contiguous annotated frame clips and visible first-frame object IDs with optional time reversal. MultiStepMultiMasksAndIous supervises sigmoid focal mask,Dice,predicted maskIoU L1/MSE and optional object-presence focal/BCE; best multimask selection depends on mask/dice loss. Pixel positives/negatives and sequence mask identity are segmentation supervision, not fish crop PK/triplet or candidate absent/unknown ID labels. Training GT prompts/corrections never qualify as observed deployment inputs.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: README supplies original SAM2 and SAM2.1 HieraTiny/Small/BasePlus/Large official URLs and HF mappings; no actual payload downloaded or independently hash/tensor coverage tested here. semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: Forward prediction with only current image,past prompt outputs/memory and no reverse pass can be causal. However select_closest_cond_frames explicitly admits both prior and later conditioning frames; memory appends all selected spatial masks. only_obj_ptrs_in_the_past_for_eval filters object pointers only, not all spatial conditioning memory. Interactive later corrections/reverse propagation can therefore use future information for earlier output. init_state video-file preload is an I/O/runtime path, not by itself proof each prediction uses future pixels. Strict online adaptation must bound all conditioning/output/cache reads to current/past and count raw frame I/O.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: Exact setup requires Python>=3.10,torch>=2.5.1/torchvision>=0.20.1,Hydra,iopath and modern NumPy/Pillow; optional CUDA connected-components extension can fail without disabling basic prediction, though postprocessing behavior may differ. Model input1024 and per-object memory can exceed small head cost; README training recipe assumes A10080GB/8GPUs, not our4x40GB authorization. No dependencies/build/model/timing were executed; do not install/upscale8GPU recipe on shared devices. BF16/compilation/offload options require same-input accuracy/runtime checks.
semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: Observed segmentation masks/quality may support an optional occlusion proxy or crop-visible-region control if prompts derive from current detector tracks. Ground-truth initial boxes/masks or later annotations are prohibited online, and MFT26 bbox labels are not actual pixel-mask/anatomy ground truth. Caller-supplied object IDs and optional mask non-overlap do not solve fish birth,unknown candidates or full learned association. WholeSAM segmentation/backbone replacement changes feature/proposal/runtime factors and must be isolated from identity/motion controls.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Use independently cleared current/past mask confidence or memory-support ideas as separate observable controls, preserving native proposals/IDs/lifecycle and full raw timing. Compare predicted masks versus boxes/simple overlap without treating pseudo masks as GT visibility. Guard conditioning spatial memory and pointers,prompt source,new object assignment,time direction and emitted-frame immutability; prohibit future corrections/reverse smoothing/GT inference. SAM object absence score is not dynamic track NULL/unknown label. Registered native ModuleB/C must still implement true identity/latent target/candidate competition rather than rename SAM memory.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: Prompt mask memory,object pointers,non-overlap and segmentation-quality/object-presence prediction are established SAM2 mechanisms. They are relevant visual/occlusion priors but not fine-grained fish identity JEPA novelty. EvidenceFishMOT needs local identity evidence and causal joint relations beyond equal-input ordinaryTransformer,mask/overlap,contrastive and motion controls; publisher mask accuracy/FPScaches cannot substantiate native tracking or scientific novelty.

IDDecoder input history/current shapes[B,G,T,N,256] concatenate256-D ID embeddings into512-D attention,16 heads (head_dim32),6 cross layers and5 same-frame candidate self layers; logits[B,G,T,N,51] for50 local ID words+newborn. TrajectoryModeling is two residual FFNs/LNs, not a temporal Transformer. Decoder uses temporal relative biases; stored boxes are not directly consumed by its attention equations at this pin.
semantic_audit.loss_and_positive_negative_construction: NaiveSampler chooses30-frame within-sequence clips with random interval1..4, epoch-local deterministic seed and annotation-legal filtering, not PK crop batches. GenerateIDLabels assigns six independent random permutations of the50-word dictionary per clip, truncating excess train identities; trajectory occlusion/switch augmentation modifies history/masks. Newborn target derives strictly from previously visible history. Train GT Hungarian matches choose DETR outputs for ID supervision, with masked CE over t>=1 (default no focal), scaled weight1 plus detector focal/L1/GIoU losses. No physical-ID labels are passed into online inference.
semantic_audit.pretrained_sources: Backbone.py uses ResNet50 ImageNet1K_V1 on the main process with FrozenBatchNorm; configured DETR initialization is COCO then target-specific detector pretrain. MODEL_ZOO lists distinct DanceTrack/SportsMOT/BFT pretrain and full MOTIP release payloads and with/without-trajectory-augmentation checkpoints. Weights were not downloaded, tensor-coverage/hash/license/overlap unverified; publisher extra-data statements are not independent MFT26 exposure audits. An IR adaptation must initialize and fit only allowed fold data.
semantic_audit.future_information_and_online_path: Cross-attention masks trajectory_time>=unknown_time, admitting strictly past trajectory tokens; candidate self-attention operates only within the same current frame. RuntimeTracker.update consumes current detector outputs and past predicted-ID memory, initializes all IDs as newborn with empty history and updates memory after assignment. Synthetic offline history occlusion and GT matching are training constructs. Decoder is causal under this current/past protocol; unrelated backbone pretraining or GT train supervision is not runtime future evidence. Relative-time index range and memory window must remain compatible.
semantic_audit.GPU_CUDA_dependencies: INSTALL recommends Python3.12,torch2.4/torchvision0.19/CUDA12.1, requires Python>=3.10 and torch>=2.0 attention-mask behavior; uses Accelerate,einops,SciPy and optional wandb. models/ops/setup.py requires CUDA available and CUDA_HOME to compile MultiScaleDeformableAttention, with no declared CPU build fallback. ID heads themselves are standard PyTorch attention, so same-input adaptation can avoid the detector operator if independently implemented. No dependencies were installed and no source model was executed/timed here.
semantic_audit.IR_MFT_compatibility: In-context local random IDs and setwise candidate competition are directly relevant to ModuleC, but50-word fixed vocabulary/newborn differs from dynamic N+1 track logits with explicit absent/unknown supervision. Full source also replaces detector/query features, thresholds and lifecycle, so its published system is not a same-detection association baseline. Default miss_tolerance30 truncates observed history and IDs are recycled to new physical output IDs; returning lost tracks competes only while supported in memory. Full candidate sets and no-history/empty frames must be adapted without cap-induced cherry-picking.
semantic_audit.mechanisms_to_port_and_exclude: Implement a disclosed MOTIP-style baseline on the exact native N-track/M-detection features, random local IDs, candidate self-attention, strict past cross-attention, masks and local relative time, with comparable parameters/train schedule. Keep default object-max and separately learned/Hungarian variants explicit. Source Hungarian repeats newborn columns to permit multiple births; object-max retains one confident candidate per supported ID and assigns others newborn. Preserve native lifecycle for association ablations and distinguish newborn, true absence and unknown/unlabelled candidates. Exclude old-engine checkpoint mixing, unverified identity exposure and GT online IDs.
semantic_audit.novelty_overlap: Random local ID words, in-context decoding, candidate self-attention and learned association are prior MOTIP contributions, not new EvidenceFishMOT claims. Fish adaptation needs evidence that local identity tokens and stopped-target prediction add information over the same-input MOTIP and ordinary Transformer/pair heads, with capacity controls. A rowwise MLP softmax that omits candidate interactions is not a faithful MOTIP-style joint decoder; scientific novelty requires controlled full-video experiments rather than naming the head differently.
